ListPreference.android:title: Poll interval
ListPreference.android:summary: Send QUERY_STATE + SLEEP_SEND this often while connected (0 = only on headband events)

CheckBoxPreference.android:title: Auto time sync
CheckBoxPreference.android:summary: Like the official app: set the headband clock after reboot/undock, only while the sleep algorithm is idle.

Preference.android:title: Forget headband
Preference.android:summary: Stop and clear the saved Zeo MAC.

CheckBoxPreference.android:title: Set oximeter clock during history sync
CheckBoxPreference.android:summary: Sends 83 (set clock) to the phone time. Off by default. Never sent unless the device reports it is idle (not recording).

Preference.android:title: Forget oximeter
Preference.android:summary: Disconnect and clear the saved oximeter MAC (stored separately from Zeo/ring).

CheckBoxPreference.android:title: Stay connected in background
CheckBoxPreference.android:summary: SleepHub's single foreground service keeps the ring GATT link alive in the background (it also runs whenever the Zeo link is enabled).

Preference.android:title: Forget ring
Preference.android:summary: Clear saved MAC and stop auto-reconnect.

ListPreference.android:title: App-triggered SpO2 interval
ListPreference.android:summary: The app starts an SpO2 measurement itself. Continuous = restart immediately after each result (~1 value/min, LED almost always on: drains the ring battery fast). Runs only while still/asleep unless set to all day.

CheckBoxPreference.android:title: Sleeping now
CheckBoxPreference.android:summary: One-tap: measure SpO2 until turned off (also in the notification). Auto-detection uses the ring's sleep state/hypnogram, else stillness + HR.

Preference.android:title: Allow running in background
Preference.android:summary: Exempt the app from battery optimisation so alarms fire on time in Doze.

Preference.android:title: Ring auto-measure intervals
Preference.android:summary: Read and set how often the ring measures HR, SpO2, HRV and stress on its own (writes a ring setting).

Preference.android:title: Command probe
Preference.android:summary: Send SAFE CRP queries/toggles. Includes 1-min sleep actigraphy (2/19), hypnogram (2/14), 30-min steps. DANGEROUS commands hidden.

CheckBoxPreference.android:title: Zeo DEMO source
CheckBoxPreference.android:summary: OFF by default. Shows a 'Start DEMO headband' button that generates simulated HMSG frames. Everything it produces is labelled DEMO.

CheckBoxPreference.android:title: Ring DEMO source
CheckBoxPreference.android:summary: OFF by default. Simulated MoYoung ring (from DaRings recreated).
